title: KAITO — Troupe Positions Open!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa finally came to SEKAI, but we didn't get a chance to do a show together with him...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was so sure he would find his true feelings if we just did a show together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that was unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well then, how about we start making preparations now for doing a show together with him the next time he drops by?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's true!
We should do that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're so clever, KAITO♪
Let's prepare for our next show with him!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what kind of show Tsukasa wants to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, he said he wanted to be a star, so maybe something glamorous and florid?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Glamorous and florid... Florid... Flo...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I get it! Flowers!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There are singing flowers everywhere around, right? Why don't we do a show together with them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm gonna go ask them about this! KAITO, go ask around too and see if there's anyone else willing to take part in the show with us☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, wait, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyone else who may be willing to take part in the show with us, huh? In that case...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And that's why I'm here.
Would all of you like to take part in our next show together?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: I wanna be in a show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Okay, this way to the stage...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: *waddle waddle*

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: *toddle toddle*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh dear... It's going to take quite a while for us to reach the stage at this rate. Here, I'll carry you guys.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Up you go!
Alright, to the stage we g—

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: What're you guys doing?

rows.Speaker: Plushie D
rows.Line: Is this a game?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, you two. Would you like to be in the show too?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good! Then grab my arm and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm happy so many of you want to join the show, but... You guys are really starting to get heavy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The stage is just ahead, though. I can do this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh?
Did everybody suddenly get lighter?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Bubbles!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: I see bubbles too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hey, wait!
Where's everyone going?!

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: I'm gonna blow the bubbles away!

rows.Speaker: Plushie D
rows.Line: So am I!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Bubbles? Where are they coming from?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO!
Look at how pretty this is♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku! Where did you get those bubbles from?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
The flowers told me about them!
The bubbles were on the ground over there, so I sent them flying here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's use flying bubbles in our show too!
Maybe Tsukasa will join us because of how sparkly they are!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope our sparkly show can help Tsukasa to find his true feelings!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I hope so too, Miku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Can I help you move the bubbles?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't see why not☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay then. Here goes! Huff!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wow! So pretty!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A smile on everyone's face is the best kind of happiness.
